title: Tandoori Tofu Bao
subtitle: with minty yoghurt sauce
description: Steamed buns filled with tandoori-marinated tofu, charred carrot and zucchini ribbons and a fresh herb yoghurt sauce.

steps.text: Make the marinade: blend the dry ingredients, garlic and coriander in a food processor. Slowly add the vinegar while blending, then the oil at the end. Process for 2 to 3 minutes until smooth.
Marinate the tofu slices (1 cm thick) in the marinade for 2 hours or up to 2 days.
Make the yoghurt sauce: mix the yoghurt with the chopped mint, a few coriander leaves and the basil leaves, salt and pepper, and adjust the seasoning. It keeps for up to 2 days in the fridge.

Heat an oiled pan. Season the carrot and zucchini ribbons (cut with a peeler) with salt and pepper and sear for about 1 minute on each side until lightly browned. Set aside. Remove the tofu from the marinade and cook for about 1 minute on each side.
Assemble: spread both sides of each steamed bun with a tablespoon or two of the yoghurt sauce, add the tofu and the vegetables and drizzle with more yoghurt sauce.
